artifact.basis: Static inspection of Sony Sound Connect Android APK; APK was not executed. Device captures below are separate live diagnostic observations supplied during the XM6 test.

inquiry.name: MODE_NC_ASM_DUAL_NC_MODE_SWITCH_AND_ASM_SEAMLESS_NA
inquiry.validation: `un0.g.f` accepts only a 9-byte array with byte 1 equal to inquiry 0x19. It validates byte 4 through NcNcssAsmMode, byte 5 through AmbientSoundMode, byte 7 through NcAsmOnOffValue, and byte 8 through NoiseAdaptiveSensitivity. The inherited parser handles the status and first on/off fields at bytes 2 and 3.

parser.inquiryDispatch: sn0.i0.b.e reads byte 1, decodes NcAsmInquiredType, and the 0x19 branch invokes sn0.m0.b.f to validate and construct sn0.m0.
parser.statusAccessor: inherited sn0.i0.e() reads ValueChangeStatus from byte 2
parser.firstOnOffAccessor: inherited sn0.i0.c() reads NcAsmOnOffValue from byte 3
parser.levelAccessor: sn0.m0.f() delegates to un0.g.a(), interpreted unsigned from byte 6

setter.builder: sn0.d1.b.h(ValueChangeStatus, NcAsmOnOffValue, NcAsmMode, AmbientSoundMode, int, NcAsmOnOffValue, NoiseAdaptiveSensitivity)
setter.fieldWriter: un0.g.g writes NcAsmMode.byteCode(), AmbientSoundMode.byteCode(), low byte of level, NcAsmOnOffValue.byteCode(), NoiseAdaptiveSensitivity.byteCode() in that order.
setter.limitation: This is an APK serializer description. It does not establish that a particular model/firmware supports or applies a SET. Live confirmation requires readback/notification after SET.

enumValues.validatorModeDiscrepancy: The validator uses NcNcssAsmMode (NC=0, ASM=1, NcSS=2), while the typed mode accessor and setter use NcAsmMode (NC=0, ASM=1). Value 2 passes the validator's enum check but maps to OUT_OF_RANGE through the typed NcAsmMode accessor.

notificationDispatch.factoryBehavior: The table-1 message factory maps NCASM_NTFY_PARAM to switch case 72 and returns a new sn0.d.b parser instance. The NCASM parameter inquiry decoder reads byte 1, maps inquiry 0x19 to sn0.m0.b.f, and validates/constructs sn0.m0.

finalHardwareVerification.result: User reports the corrected rebuilt Windows app matches all three tested NC/ASM mode selections, confirms the requested state, and follows physical NC/AMB button changes.
finalHardwareVerification.source: User-confirmed end-to-end hardware test after corrected binary rebuild

liveObservations.limit: The raw byte captures are user-provided live diagnostic observations; the static APK inspection does not independently validate the captures. Hardware verification is specific to WH-1000XM6 firmware 3.1.5 on Windows and does not establish support on XM5, CH720N, macOS, or Linux.
